description: Explains one accessibility rule (an axe-core rule id such as image-alt or color-contrast): what is wrong, why it matters for customers, who is affected, how to fix it in code and on Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop or Shoptet, and the WCAG 2.2 / EN 301 549 clauses. Free, no API token needed.

platform.description: Only the tip for this platform, for example shopify or woocommerce.

rule.description: axe-core rule id, for example image-alt.

name: explain_rule
title: Explain an accessibility rule
